description: Header file defining the Http3Response class for handling HTTP/3 responses over QUIC streams, including methods for writing headers, status, data, and attaching event handlers.

classes.name: Http3Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 response over a QUIC stream, providing methods to send headers, data, and handle events.

methods.name: endWithoutBody
methods.description: Ends the response without sending a body.

methods.name: tryEnd
methods.description: Attempts to send the response data and finalize the response.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the response (currently empty implementation).

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the response, optionally with data and connection closure.

methods.name: onAborted
methods.description: Attaches a handler for aborted requests.

methods.name: onData
methods.description: Attaches a handler for incoming data.

methods.name: onWritable
methods.description: Attaches a handler for writable events.
